regles.texte: The work folder is named NN_sujet (two digits, underscore, lowercase letters, digits and underscores).
Mandatory subfolders: 00_sources, 95_journal, 98_livrables, 99_livrables_modifiables.
Permitted first-level subfolders: 00_sources; 01_ to 89_ (steps, in order); 90_scripts; 95_journal; 98_livrables; 99_livrables_modifiables.
At the root of the work folder, only LISEZMOI_vN.md and TRAVAIL_vN.json.
TRAVAIL_vN.json describes the work: sujet, source, auteur_revisions, version_cible, couverture (range of unmodifiable paragraphs), auteurs_relecteurs.
LISEZMOI_vN.md present: role of each folder, state of the work, deliverables.
00_sources contains sha256_sources_vN.txt; each source appears in it and its checksum is unchanged.
The files in 00_sources are read-only.
98_livrables contains empreintes_livrables_vM.0.0.txt; each deliverable appears in it, its checksum is unchanged, and the file is read-only.
Each deliverable in 98_livrables has its copy of the same name in 99_livrables_modifiables.
Never overwrite: since the previous manifest (95_journal/manifestes), no file has changed content or disappeared (an append-only file is flagged, non-blocking).
Every file carries a version: nom_vN.ext, Nom_vX.Y.Z[a|c][_variante].ext or nom_AAAAMMJJ_HHMM.ext (exempt: 00_sources, trial and technical folders).
No spaces or accents in the names created by Claude (except in 00_sources).

Deliverables (98, 99): version = version_cible of TRAVAIL, equal to the expected version: a rule or decision of the user specific to the document, recorded in TRAVAIL (decision_version, approved by the user; e.g. report: source v6.0.4-rev1 → v6.0.5-rev1), otherwise the general convention v(X+1).0.0, X = initial version of the source; all the deliverables of the folder carry this version. Does not apply to tools (versioning _vN).
Revision of a document outside the deliverables: vX.Y.N followed by c (Claude) or a (author), N increasing.
A version (name, version, variant, extension) designates only one content throughout the folder.

Comment by a Claude author in a Word deliverable: at most 400 characters, starts with `Fait :` ("Done:"), `Proposition :` ("Proposal:"), `Données :` ("Data:"), `Question :` ("Question:"), `Non retenu :` ("Not retained:") or `Conforme :` ("Compliant:") (or a [Correction …] header).
A single reply per thread for the author of the pass.
Word deliverable: XSD validation and tracked-changes validation successful (validate.py of the docx skill).
All the comments of the source are present, text intact.
Rejecting the revisions of the author of the pass gives back the source (text, formatting, revisions of the other authors).
The coverage (range declared in TRAVAIL) is unchanged.
A single new revision author per pass, the one declared in TRAVAIL.
Lesson L3: the revisions of the reviewers present in the source remain present in the deliverable under tracked changes (never accepted in bulk).
